parameters.content:
## CGPE Client Communication Automation
Trusted AI/system POSTs a message request to /webhook/cgpe-claim-message.
Categories: claim, greeting (birthday/anniversary), policy/renewal, billing (premium/payment), promotion, custom.
Flow: Validate -> Idempotency -> Verify Client (clients) -> Build safe multilingual message -> (Dev) Simulate / (Live) Meta Cloud API -> Persist tracking -> JSON response.
Inactive by design. Send gated by safeMode (default true) AND the Send node is disabled until go-live.

## Security & Compliance
- Webhook Header Auth (credential: CGPE Claim Webhook Auth) - unauthorized requests rejected before logic runs.
- requestId + createdBy required; optional createdBy allowlist.
- Idempotency on requestId prevents duplicate sends.
- Promotions require explicit consent=true and auto-append an opt-out line.
- Sanitization strips HTML, links, template-injection and redacts long digit runs (Aadhaar/card/account).

## Go-Live Toggles (do NOT enable without approval)
1. Set DEV_SAFE_MODE = false in Validate & Normalize Request.
2. Enable the disabled Send WhatsApp Message (Meta Cloud API) node.
3. Configure credential CGPE Meta WhatsApp Token (Authorization: Bearer token).
4. Confirm wa_bot_config has botId cgpe_main with metaPhoneNumberId.
5. Create indexes: wa_comm_messages.requestId (unique), wa_comm_threads.threadRef (unique), wa_comm_audit.
6. For promotions, ensure WhatsApp marketing template approval & consent records.
